chunks: And in the narration of Muʿāwiyah ibn ʿAmmār, he said: Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام said:
If you wish to perform tawaf around the House on behalf of one of your brothers, then go to the Black Stone and say: In the Name of Allah, O Allah, accept from so-and-so.

key_terms.إِخْوَانِكَ: your brothers, here meaning fellow believers
key_terms.اللَّهُمَّ تَقَبَّلْ: O Allah, accept; a supplication asking for acceptance
key_terms.الْحَجَرَ الْأَسْوَدَ: the Black Stone at the Kaʿbah
key_terms.بِالْبَيْتِ: around the House, meaning the Kaʿbah
key_terms.بِسْمِ اللَّهِ: In the Name of Allah; opening invocation
key_terms.تَطُوفَ: to perform tawaf, circling the Kaʿbah in worship

ai.seo_question: What should one say when performing tawaf on behalf of another person?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches the wording to be said when performing tawaf on behalf of another person. It shows the permissibility of acting devotionally on behalf of a fellow believer and instructs that the supplication for acceptance be made at the Black Stone.
